```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FILE: vignettes/plot-controls.Rmd
# FULL WORKING — VIGNETTE SHOWS PLOTS (Scenario 1 & 2)
# ============================================================

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "900px",
  fig.path = "plot-controls_files/figure-html/"
)

if (!requireNamespace("DDESONN", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
    devtools::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)
  } else {
    stop("DDESONN is not installed and devtools is unavailable.")
  }
}

library(DDESONN)
set.seed(111)

.print_core_metrics <- function(res, label = "RUN") {
  cat("\n\n====================================================================\n")
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat("====================================================================\n\n")
  if (!is.null(res$train_metrics)) print(res$train_metrics)
  if (!is.null(res$validation_metrics)) print(res$validation_metrics)
  if (!is.null(res$test_metrics)) print(res$test_metrics)
}

.vignette_fig_root <- function(subdir) {
  od <- knitr::opts_knit$get("output.dir")
  if (is.null(od) || !nzchar(od)) od <- getwd()
  fp_rel <- knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path")
  if (is.null(fp_rel) || !nzchar(fp_rel)) fp_rel <- "figure/"
  fp_abs <- file.path(od, fp_rel)
  dir.create(fp_abs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  p <- file.path(fp_abs, subdir)
  dir.create(p, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  p
}

.include_saved_plots <- function(output_root, max_n = 200L) {
  if (!dir.exists(output_root)) return(invisible(NULL))

  # #$$$$$$$$$$$$$ FIX: valid regex escape for literal dot in ".png"
  imgs <- list.files(output_root, pattern = "\\.png$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)  #$$$$$$$$$$$$$

  if (!length(imgs)) return(invisible(NULL))
  imgs <- imgs[seq_len(min(length(imgs), as.integer(max_n)))]

  od <- knitr::opts_knit$get("output.dir")
  if (is.null(od) || !nzchar(od)) od <- getwd()

  base <- normalizePath(od, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  rel <- sub(paste0("^", base, "/?"), "", normalizePath(imgs, winslash = "/"))
  knitr::include_graphics(rel)
}
```

## Load example data

```{r data}
ext_dir <- system.file("extdata", package = "DDESONN")
if (!nzchar(ext_dir)) stop("Could not find DDESONN extdata folder. Is the package installed?", call. = FALSE)

df <- read.csv(file.path(ext_dir, "heart_failure_clinical_records.csv"))
y <- as.numeric(df$DEATH_EVENT)
x <- as.matrix(df[, setdiff(names(df), "DEATH_EVENT")])

n <- nrow(x)
idx <- sample(seq_len(n))
n_train <- floor(0.7 * n)
n_valid <- floor(0.15 * n)

x_train <- x[idx[1:n_train], , drop = FALSE]
y_train <- y[idx[1:n_train]]
x_valid <- x[idx[(n_train + 1):(n_train + n_valid)], , drop = FALSE]
y_valid <- y[idx[(n_train + 1):(n_train + n_valid)]]
x_test  <- x[idx[(n_train + n_valid + 1):n], , drop = FALSE]
y_test  <- y[idx[(n_train + n_valid + 1):n]]
```

## Scenario 1 — training_overrides

```{r scenario1}
out1 <- .vignette_fig_root("DDESONN_plots_s1")
options(DDESONN_OUTPUT_ROOT = out1)
Sys.setenv(DDESONN_ARTIFACTS_ROOT = out1)

res_s1 <- ddesonn_run(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  classification_mode = "binary",
  seeds = 1,
  validation = list(x = x_valid, y = y_valid),
  test = list(x = x_test, y = y_test),
  training_overrides = list(
    validation_metrics = TRUE,
    per_epoch_view_plots = list(
      accuracy_plot = TRUE,
      saturation_plot = TRUE,
      max_weight_plot = TRUE
    )
  )
)

.print_core_metrics(res_s1, "SCENARIO 1")
.include_saved_plots(ddesonn_plots_dir(out1))
```

## Scenario 2 — plot_controls

```{r scenario2}
out2 <- .vignette_fig_root("DDESONN_plots_s2")
options(DDESONN_OUTPUT_ROOT = out2)
Sys.setenv(DDESONN_ARTIFACTS_ROOT = out2)

res_s2 <- ddesonn_run(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  classification_mode = "binary",
  seeds = 1,
  validation = list(x = x_valid, y = y_valid),
  test = list(x = x_test, y = y_test),
  plot_controls = list(
    per_epoch = list(
      accuracy_plot = TRUE,
      saturation_plot = TRUE,
      max_weight_plot = TRUE
    )
  ),
  training_overrides = list(validation_metrics = TRUE)
)

.print_core_metrics(res_s2, "SCENARIO 2")
.include_saved_plots(ddesonn_plots_dir(out2))
```
